name.en: Runge interpolation: nodes, representation and rounding — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 格納値の補間多項式P、閉重み有理式R、格納係数級数C、目標関数fを区別。17点の正確な有理参照・演算別誤差上界・節点一致・固定Runge傾向を照合します。
note.en: Separate the stored-data polynomial P, closed-weight rational expression R, stored-coefficient series C and target f. Check exact rational references at 17 probes, operation-based error bounds, node identities and fixed Runge trends.

name.ja: 節点・表現・丸めを分けるRunge補間
name.en: Runge interpolation: nodes, representation and rounding

note.ja: 解析解 無次元区間[-1,1]、次数8・16・32、固定2048中点。節点・データ・重みは実際のbinary64値を対象にします。 標本最大誤差は連続一様ノルムの証明ではありません。丸め節点の閉重み・離散直交性は厳密と見なしません。任意次数・任意点の安定性は保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless interval [-1,1], degrees 8, 16 and 32, and 2048 fixed midpoints. Actual binary64 nodes, data and weights define the discrete problem. A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made.

name.ja: 自然・端点微分指定スプラインとPCHIP：参照・比較条件
name.en: Natural and clamped splines versus PCHIP — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 正確な有理2階微分系・有理PCHIP・SciPy 1.14.1を照合。端点15記録は16スカラー出力・13異なる入力。平坦部の負値は実binary64をFraction化した独立式で示します。
note.en: Compare with exact rational second-derivative systems, rational PCHIP and SciPy 1.14.1. Fifteen endpoint records contain sixteen scalar outputs from thirteen distinct inputs. Independent Fraction formulas show plateau undershoot for the actual binary64 data.

name.ja: 自然・端点微分指定スプラインとPCHIP
name.en: Natural and clamped splines versus PCHIP

note.ja: 解析解 実binary64の節点と値を使用。自然条件は両端2階微分ゼロ、clamped条件は入力端点1階微分です。 PCHIPは通常C1でありC2とは限りません。一般データの最良近似・外挿・ノイズ平滑化は対象外。SciPyは原著完全閲読の代用ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Use actual binary64 knots and values. Natural conditions set both endpoint second derivatives to zero; clamped conditions prescribe the first derivatives from the input. PCHIP is generally C1, not necessarily C2. Best approximation, extrapolation and noise smoothing are outside scope. A SciPy comparison does not substitute for reading the original papers.

name.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値：参照・比較条件
name.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。
note.en: Use twelve analyses and thirty-six reconstructions. Check independent matrices, Fraction/Decimal coefficients, perfect reconstruction and squared L2 errors. Require the orthogonal error identity only at length 32; retain level-by-level padding energy at length 17.

name.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値
name.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds

note.ja: 解析解 奇数長の各段で周期型は先頭、対称型は末尾を1点追加し、再構成時に切り戻します。詳細係数のみ閾値0.2を使用。 Haarに限定し長いフィルタや画像圧縮は対象外。一般の対称拡張に正規直交性を仮定しません。シフト不変性は要求せず、シフト別差を保存します。
note.en: Analytic reference At each odd-length level append the first sample for periodic extension or the last for symmetric extension, then crop during synthesis. Apply threshold 0.2 only to detail coefficients. Limited to Haar, without longer filters or image compression. General symmetric extension is not assumed orthonormal. Shift invariance is not required; shift-dependent differences are retained.
